replies.author: ManofGraphene
replies.text: As far as I know, there is no way to clear it. However, you could try clearing storage and cache of the system app titled "sounds". Might be worth a shot. Just be aware that clearing an app's cache/storage can be risky because I believe it deletes all settings for that app. You would not want to do this for any apps you have important information on. Hope this helps!
